findings.why: The proposal is BR-180 pilot builds at Plant 3 (TO3) for STL with billet from Alluminio B Settimo. The only Alluminio B approval for BR-180 and STL (AP-0208) is for plant TO1. The current ASL does not cover TO3, so no controlled record covers this part, plant and customer. The absence of an approval therefore cannot be read as 'not approved'. Someone must confirm whether a TO3 release exists elsewhere.
